jobs.title: Principal Product Manager, AI Build Governance
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

AI Governance is one of the fastest-emerging categories in enterprise software. The first Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI Governance Platforms was published this year, and OneTrust is named a Visionary in it.

OneTrust is looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the developer-facing products in our AI Governance solution to own it’s early success and growing adoption.

These products live within the AI development lifecycle an engineer already follows when it builds an AI system: writing prompts, wiring up retrieval and tools, evaluating what the system actually does, and deciding it is ready to ship. You own the governance tooling and checks that live at those steps, and the work is to turn governance requirements into controls a developer can implement and test.

You will define what we build, ship it with a dedicated engineering and design team, and prove it with measurable outcomes. You will work daily with Engineering, UX, and other Product Managers, and you will prototype and build with modern AI development tools.

Your Mission

- Define and own the product strategy, roadmap, and packaging for OneTrust's developer-facing AI governance products

- Translate governance requirements into technical requirements, tests, and controls that developers can act on

- Own the developer experience end to end, including SDK design, APIs, documentation, samples, and CI/CD integration

- Set requirements earlier in the lifecycle carry into the build, and that signals from production carry back into future evaluations

- Work with design partners and early access customers to validate direction against real engineering teams

- Partner with Product Marketing, Sales Engineering, on positioning, launches, and the technical narrative

- Own the outcomes: developer adoption, integration depth, and the revenue and retention these products influence

You Are

A hands-on product leader with a track record of strong product ownership and demonstrated product-led growth. You have shipped developer-facing products, and you are comfortable with ambiguity. You work well at speed, building for where the market is right now and revising as it moves.

- Builder  — You prototype. When a team is deciding on an API shape or an interaction, you open the tools and show them one. You are comfortable in a repo and an SDK.

- Developer empathy  — You have built products where the user was an engineer, and you know adoption is won on time-to-first-integration, documentation, and good defaults.

- Collaborator  — Most of what you own depends on work other teams are doing, and you spend as much time inside their plans as your own. You build alignment and confidence across other teams without having authority over them.

- Zero-to-one  — You have taken new products from nothing to real customers and real revenue, knowing full well what it takes.

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

- 12+ years of product management experience in enterprise software, including end-to-end ownership of a technical product area

- Demonstrated success taking new products from concept to shipped, adopted, and generating revenue

- Strong working knowledge of the modern AI stack: LLMs and model providers, agents and tool calling, RAG pipelines, prompts, and their failure modes

- Familiarity with AI evaluation practice, including benchmarking, offline and online evaluation, red teaming, and safety testing

- Proven ability to partner deeply with Engineering, UX, Security, and Legal, and to earn technical credibility with senior engineers

- Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate vision, create alignment, and represent new products credibly

A major plus:

- Experience building developer tools or developer platforms — SDKs, APIs, CLIs, IDE extensions, CI/CD integrations, or testing frameworks — where engineers were your primary user

- Fluency using AI tools to build product: prototyping in code with coding agents, building your own evals, and shipping AI-assisted workflows

Also preferred:

- Hands-on experience with AI security or safety controls such as guardrails, prompt injection defenses, content filtering, or output validation

- Familiarity with AI regulations and frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001

- Experience with design partner programs, early access programs, or developer relations

Where we Work

We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.

Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.

Benefits

As an employee at  OneTrust , you will be part of the OneTeam . That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:

- OneTrust Careers on YouTube

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our  Privacy Overview .  You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the  Data Subject Request Form .

Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com .

Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.

Principal PM AI Governance - Runtime Governance

About OneTrust

OneTrust helps organizations operationalize trust through privacy, security, data governance, and responsible technology adoption. As AI governance becomes a board-level and regulatory priority, customers increasingly need structured ways to understand AI systems, assess risk, monitor behavior, and demonstrate compliance over time.

The Challenge

We are looking for a Principal PM to help shape the future of our AI Governance product with a specific focus on observability and enforcement across AI systems. This role is for a product manager who can connect strategy, execution, and technical depth to help us build the right platform capabilities for the next generation of governed AI.

You will help run squad activities and drive clarity across product, engineering, design, and go-to-market stakeholders to ensure we are building capabilities that are durable, differentiated, and ready for where AI governance is heading next. The ideal candidate brings a strong product mindset along with a background in cybersecurity, SIEM and AI/MLOps.

Your Mission

Own and drive product direction for core AI Governance capabilities related to observability, policy enforcement, controls, and signal-driven governance across AI systems.

You will help define how customers can:

- Gain visibility into AI systems, models, agents, and their behaviors over time using SIEM solutions

- Collect and operationalize governance signals across development, deployment, and runtime environments

- Enforce policies to build responsible AI and secure-AI use cases

- Investigate risk, drift, policy violations, and operational issues with confidence

- Connect governance requirements to measurable controls, workflows, and evidence for compliance outcomes

- Partner with engineering and design to run an effective squad cadence, maintain clarity on priorities, and turn ambiguous opportunities into actionable product direction

- Work closely with internal and external stakeholders to understand market needs, technical constraints, and regulatory expectations

- Ensure product choices balance near-term customer value with long-term platform extensibility

- Support launches, customer conversations, and strategic storytelling for this area of the portfolio

What Success Looks Like

- The squad is operating with strong product clarity, execution discipline, and measurable outcomes

- Customers can observe meaningful AI system behavior and governance signals in a way that supports action, not just reporting

- Enforcement capabilities are practical, scalable, and aligned to real enterprise governance workflows

- The product roadmap anticipates where AI governance is going, not just where the market is today

- Cross-functional partners see this product area as strategically coherent, technically credible, and commercially important

You Are

- A strong product manager who can operate comfortably in technical, ambiguous, and fast-moving domains

- Fluent in cybersecurity concepts such as controls, risk signals, policy enforcement, monitoring, and incident-oriented thinking

- Experienced in AI/MLOps ecosystems, with experience in building SIEM and SOAR solutions including model lifecycle considerations, evaluation signals, runtime monitoring, and production governance patterns

- Comfortable leading through influence across engineering, design, GTM, and executive stakeholders

- Structured in how you run product discovery, prioritization, and squad execution

- Future-oriented and able to identify platform capabilities that will matter as AI systems become more agentic, distributed, and operationally complex

- Clear and persuasive in written and verbal communication

Your Experience Includes

- 12+ years in product management, with meaningful experience in enterprise software or platform products

- Direct experience in one or more of the following domains: log collection, inference generation, cybersecurity, AI/MLOps, , platform observability, or risk/compliance technology

- Track record of shipping technical platform capabilities in partnership with engineering teams

- Experience working with telemetry, monitoring, policy, controls, or enforcement-oriented systems

- Ability to understand complex technical architectures and convert them into strong product decisions

- Experience balancing customer needs, technical feasibility, and strategic platform thinking

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience

Extra Impressive

- Experience with AI governance, model risk, or responsible AI programs.

- Have built SIEM capabilities or product to drive meaningful signals.

- Familiarity with enterprise AI stacks, agent frameworks, or evaluation/monitoring pipelines

- Experience building products that connect governance requirements to operational systems and evidence

- Background working in privacy, security, compliance, or trust-related software markets

- Comfort engaging with strategic partners, large enterprise customers, and senior leadership on product direction

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to join our dynamic and collaborative Product Organization. Staff Product Managers will organize, define, prioritize and lead the execution of a complex product roadmap, usually responsible for more than one product in the product line. Staff Product Managers lead product teams and coach/mentor Product Owners and Product Managers. Staff Product Managers are key members in aligning solution designs into new platform services and identifying new product opportunities to drive new business growth.

Your Mission

- Successful delivery of multiple products within product line

- Act as SME for product while growing knowledge of adjacent products

- Outline product strategy (customer value, competitive position, business value)

- Define product goals and themes (OKRs)

- Drive product initiatives and lead geographically distributed cross‑functional teams

- Drive alignment across product teams and GTM teams, contributing to GTM plan with Product Marketing, Sales, and Partner teams

- Set and clearly communicate development objectives, needs, and status of projects to internal stakeholders and customers

- Act as primary escalation point for product line, de‑escalating and communicating

You Are

A subject matter expert in your product line, who can handle significant complexity in your role and exercises independent and sound judgement. Someone who thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment while juggling multiple personas and prioritize competing tasks and deadlines to deliver on aggressive timelines. You are capable of supervising activities, projects, and teams.

jobs.title: Staff Product Manager - AI Detection & Discovery
jobs.description:
Strength in Trust

OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.

The Challenge

You cannot govern what you cannot see. AI is entering the enterprise faster than any technology before it—often without a ticket: a team deploys a foundation model endpoint in an unmonitored cloud account, an engineer self-hosts an open-weight model, or a SaaS vendor quietly adds an AI feature to a widely used tool.

OneTrust is looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Detection—the discovery layer that finds AI models, LLM applications, agents, and AI-enabled features wherever they run, and turns that visibility into a governable inventory. Detection is the front door to AI governance: every downstream risk assessment, policy control, and compliance obligation depends on the completeness and accuracy of what you surface.

Your Mission

Strategy & Roadmap

- Own product strategy for the Detection area across multiple related products, balancing delivery across the full product line.

- Set the Shadow AI detection strategy: discover unsanctioned models, applications, and agents; attribute owners; risk-rank assets; and route them into governance and remediation workflows.

- Define and sequence the coverage roadmap across detection surfaces, weighing build vs. partner decisions, connector investment, and the risk retired by each incremental surface.

- Establish the  detection taxonomy and definition of a “discovered AI asset,” bringing models, hosted endpoints, fine-tunes, RAG pipelines, agents, and embedded vendor features into one coherent inventory.

- Own the quality bar with measurable targets for coverage, precision, recall, time-to-discovery, and false-positive  rate ; make tradeoffs explicit.

- Identify adjacent opportunities, including continuous monitoring, AI bill of materials, third-party and supply-chain AI risk, and usage telemetry.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Lead geographically distributed engineering, design, data science, and detection research teams through ambiguous, discovery-heavy problems.

- Align with Product Marketing, Sales, and Partners on positioning and go-to-market in a category where buyers compare coverage claims.

- Partner with Security, IT, and Legal stakeholders—internally  and at design-partner customers—to test detection signals against real enterprise adoption.

- Work with Ecosystem and Partnerships on cloud marketplaces and integrations with adjacent tools (CSPM, SSPM, CASB, IdP, EDR, and SaaS management) where telemetry can be shared rather than rebuilt.

Technical & Domain Depth

- Serve as the Detection subject matter expert while building knowledge of adjacent AI governance and privacy products.

- Bring deep understanding of AI deployment, including managed model services (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI), commercial LLM APIs, self-hosted open-weight models and inference servers, fine-tuning and training pipelines, vector databases, RAG architectures, and agent frameworks.

- Understand detection mechanics well enough to make hard approach decisions across API and control-plane enumeration, log and network telemetry, OAuth and identity analysis, code and dependency scanning, endpoint and browser signals, and vendor questionnaires or attestations where technical discovery cannot reach.

- Translate requirements from the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and emerging state AI laws into concrete detection and inventory requirements.

Escalation & Communication

- Serve as the primary escalation point for the product line, de-escalating issues and communicating clearly from individual engineers to executives.

- Represent  Detection strategy with customers, analysts, and prospects, and bring those insights back into the roadmap.

Mentorship

- Informally mentor Product Managers and Associate Product Managers, sharing strategic and domain expertise .

- Raise the broader product organization’s bar for reasoning about AI systems, detection quality, and evidence-based prioritization.

You Are

A subject matter expert who handles significant complexity and exercises independent judgment. You set direction when the problem space is still forming, are sought out by Product Managers for strategic guidance, and thrive while juggling multiple priorities under aggressive timelines. You are intellectually honest about detection quality: you would rather ship narrower coverage you can defend than a number that fails a customer audit.

Your Experience Includes

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science , Engineering, Business, or a related field.

- 8+ years of Product Management experience.

- Proven success managing a product through its full lifecycle, including end-of-life planning.

- Experience shipping discovery, inventory, or  detection products in security, data discovery, asset management, CSPM/SSPM/CASB, observability, or a comparable domain where coverage and signal quality are the product.

- Working fluency with cloud platforms and AI services, as well as on-premises and self-hosted inference stacks; able to contribute effectively  in architecture reviews.

- Experience with integration and connector-heavy products, including  maintaining them as upstream APIs change.

- Experience contributing to technical debt and automation-backlog planning.

- Recent experience using Agile/Scrum  methodology .

- Hands-on professional use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI, or similar) to accelerate research synthesis, PRD writing, or roadmap analysis, with genuine enthusiasm for applying AI to product work.

Bonus Points For

- Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and regulation , including the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO/IEC 42001.

- Background in enterprise security or IT tooling, or experience selling to CISO and Chief Data/AI Officer buyers.

- Experience with data-quality or ML-driven classification problems where precision and recall are negotiated with customers.

- Exposure to agentic systems, MCP, or AI supply-chain risk.
